rival_rationales.name: Hootsuite
rival_rationales.why: Both vendors gate team approval workflows behind a higher-tier plan: Hootsuite's Advanced plan promises to 'Streamline approvals and co-work across teams' and to 'Review and approve content with your team,' while Buffer's Team plan is the only tier offering 'Content approval workflows: Manage who can draft and approve posts across your team,' with the feature explicitly 'Not included' on Free or Essentials. Hootsuite separately reserves 'advanced analytics' and 'advanced listening' for its Enterprise tier, which is consistent with upgrade buyers seeking deeper reporting and listening looking past entry tiers. This parallel tiering does not establish that Buffer lacks equivalent reporting, listening, or approval capability outright — only that both companies place richer collaboration features on their upper plans.

rival_rationales.name: Later
rival_rationales.why: Later's pricing page lists Instagram First Comment as included ("Yes") on every plan, including the entry-level Starter plan, while Buffer's own pricing page states first comment scheduling is "Not included" on its Free plan and only included on paid Essentials and Team plans. Both companies otherwise include a full visual content calendar across all their plans, so this is a documented difference in one specific Instagram feature's plan gating rather than a broader capability gap.

rival_rationales.name: Metricool
rival_rationales.why: Metricool's own FAQ defines a brand as covering one profile per social network or ad platform, so added networks under a brand don't add a separate bill the way they do on Buffer, which the sourced Buffer pricing page says bills per channel so a portfolio of 30 accounts costs the same whether it's one brand or 15. This supports the hypothesis that Metricool's brand-based pricing can avoid Buffer's per-channel scaling for a solo marketer or small team adding networks under one brand, while Buffer's model instead keeps cost flat across many brands with few channels each.
